Logan Wright is the director of China markets research at Rhodium Group and senior associate of the Trustee Chair in Chinese Business and Economics at the Center for Strategic and International Studies. He has studied the expansion of credit in China, the Chinese government’s deleveraging campaign, and local government debt.
